title: Services
description: Is each service running, and what is it complaining about?

panels.title: Services stopped
panels.description: Services the last deploy started to keep running that have no running container; A service stopped fires after 10 minutes.

targets.expr: count(max by (project, service) (homelab_container_expected) * 0 unless on (project, service) label_replace(label_replace(container_last_seen{job="docker",container_label_com_docker_compose_oneoff="False"}, "project", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_project", "(.+)"), "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)")) or vector(0)

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Alert rules firing now; a rule with several firing series counts once.

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: Each alert rule firing now, its level and when it began; empty when none fires. The Services page lists what fired earlier.

panels.title: Each service, running or stopped
panels.description: Every service the last deploy started to keep running: green while its container runs, red while it does not.

targets.expr: (max by (project, service) (homelab_container_expected) and on (project, service) label_replace(label_replace(container_last_seen{job="docker",container_label_com_docker_compose_oneoff="False"}, "project", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_project", "(.+)"), "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)")) or (max by (project, service) (homelab_container_expected) * 0 unless on (project, service) label_replace(label_replace(container_last_seen{job="docker",container_label_com_docker_compose_oneoff="False"}, "project", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_project", "(.+)"), "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Top 10 by CPU now, cores
panels.description: The busiest containers over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Top 10 by memory now
panels.description: The containers holding the most memory.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Each container's working set, the memory it cannot give back.

panels.title: Error lines per hour, by container
panels.description: Lines that log an error, a fatal or a Python exception. Alloy resends a container's recent lines when it restarts; this chart counts those twice (stats over a range cannot drop repeats first), the table below does not.

targets.expr: (i(error) or i(fatal) or i(panic) or i(crit) or i(critical) or i(exception) or i(limited)) (level:in(error, fatal, critical) or _msg:~`(^|"msg":").{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(^|"msg":")(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |(^|"msg":")[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): `) | stats by (container_name) count() as lines

panels.title: Most repeated error lines, last hour
panels.description: Numbers and ids show as #, so repeats of one error count together; each line is cut at 80 characters.

targets.expr: _time:1h (i(error) or i(fatal) or i(panic) or i(crit) or i(critical) or i(exception) or i(limited)) (level:in(error, fatal, critical) or _msg:~`(^|"msg":").{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(^|"msg":")(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |(^|"msg":")[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): `) | uniq by (_time, container_name, _msg) | replace_regexp ("^observability-|-1$", "") at container_name | replace_regexp ("^[{].*?\"(?:msg|message)\":\"([^\"]*)\".*$", "$1") at _msg | replace_regexp (`\x1b\[[0-9;]*m|^\S*\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[T ][0-9:.,]+\S*\s*`, "") at _msg | replace_regexp ("[0-9a-f]*[0-9][0-9a-f]*", "#") at _msg | extract_regexp `^(?P<line>.{0,80})` from _msg | stats by (container_name, line) count() as hits | sort by (hits desc) limit 20

panels.title: Alerts that fired
panels.description: Each rule that fired in the time range, first and last minute it fired, and its minutes firing; still firing if its last time is this minute.

panels.title: Rules firing, by hour
panels.description: Minutes each rule fired in each hour.

panels.title: Entities down
panels.description: Entities Home Assistant reports unavailable or unknown, from its Prometheus endpoint; entities with no state of their own (buttons, events, notify, tts) are left out. No rule reads it.

panels.title: Entities down now
panels.description: Each entity counted in Entities down: its domain, id and name. Unknown and unavailable look the same here; Home Assistant's own page tells them apart.

panels.title: Setup failures
panels.description: Home Assistant's log lines for an integration or platform that failed to set up, was not ready, could not log in, or could not add an entity, each with how often and when last, in the time range (pick a longer one for more). Its Prometheus endpoint has no integration state, so this reads the logs.

targets.expr: container_name:="homeassistant" ("Error setting up entry" or "Setup failed for" or "not ready yet" or "could not authenticate" or "Error during setup of component" or "Unable to prepare setup" or "Unable to set up dependencies" or "Error while setting up" or "Error adding entity") | uniq by (_time, _msg) | unpack_json from _msg fields (msg) | format if (msg:="") "<_msg>" as msg | extract_regexp `\] (?P<line>.{0,100})` from msg | replace_regexp ("[0-9]+ seconds", "# seconds") at line | stats by (line) count() as lines, max(_time) as last | sort by (last desc) limit 20

panels.title: Blog data age
panels.description: How old the home-lab numbers colincheung.dev/homelab.json serves are (public_stats.py pushes every 5 minutes; probes.py reads them back). Amber past 30 minutes. A failing push already alerts as public-stats unhealthy; no data means the blog could not be read.

panels.title: Certificate days left
panels.description: Days until each public site's TLS certificate expires, from the blackbox probes. Cloudflare renews them about 30 days ahead; amber under 14 days means renewal is late.
